Make one ORIGINAL production fantasy MOBA icon sprite sheet, square, exact4x4=16 equal square cells, flush edge-to-edge, no gutters, no frames, no lettering or numerals. Hand-painted realistic fantasy materials/light matching classic PC spell icons, not flat clipart. Dark quiet backgrounds and ONE LARGE bright dominant object/action silhouette per cell, occupies80% of cell with8%safe margin. Readable when reduced to32px: no tiny scenery, no texture noise, no extra props, no busy crowds. Dimensional steel/cloth/skin/fire/vines, high light-dark separation, cohesive palette within hero kit. Do not copy an existing game's art. Mechanics below guide accurate representation; no claim every game rule can fit in an icon. Exact row-major cells:
ROW1 COL1: Underworld Presence. Black soul wisps streaming from fallen nearby bodies into a black armored swordsman; green healing light in his chest, strong inward flow. Effect: Every unit that dies within 1000 of Blackfire gives its soul to him: he heals 4% of his maximum health, 10% for a hero (150% more).
ROW1 COL2: Sacrificial Grip. A black spectral hand binds one enemy while dark cords also hold the black armored caster still; a small red life stream drains from the living victim. Effect: Blackfire grips an enemy unit with the Underworld: the target and Blackfire are both stunned for 2 / 2.2 / 2.4 / 2.6 seconds, and the target loses 25% of its current health as pure damage (this never kills). After the stun both deal 30% less attack damage for 2 seconds. Meanwhile his Undead go for the target first.
ROW1 COL3: Rise Up. A roaring black armored swordsman surrounded by three fallen armored creeps rising from the soil as dark undead; upward reaching arms and dark violet light. Effect: Blackfire lets out a deafening roar: the fresh bodies within 1000 rise at once as his Undead for 20 seconds, his to command. The roar stays on him for 20 seconds and raises whatever dies within 1000 meanwhile; the raised stay their 20 seconds after it ends. Ancient creeps, heroes, buildings, summoned units and tamed beasts do not rise. The Undead give no gold or experience.
ROW1 COL4: Fiend Edge. Massive black greatsword landing a bright violet critical strike, green healing streams branching back to its wielder and nearby allies. Effect: Blackfire's great sword is corrupted with the Underworld: a 10 / 15 / 20 / 25% chance to strike a critical hit for 2x damage. A critical hit heals every ally within 800 (Blackfire too) for 20 / 25 / 30 / 35% of its damage.
ROW2 COL1: Unfallen. Black armored greatsword warrior rising above his fallen dark silhouette, full green life light and a final outward violet shock ring; resurrection dominates. Effect: Blackfire cannot stay dead. When he dies he lies still for 3 seconds, then springs back to life with full health and 25% more damage, armor, movement speed and attack speed for 3 / 4 / 5 seconds, and then dies for good (sooner if he is killed again). As his life ends he lets out a blast: every unit within 400, allies too, is thrown 300 away from him, and any that slams into a wall, a tree or another unit is stunned for 0.5 seconds.
ROW2 COL2: Divine Touch. A glowing white hand building three nested gold-white protective layers around a winged swordsman; clear intact barrier, no healing cross. Effect: Every spell Thyrandael casts gives him a charge of Divine Touch: an All-damage Barrier as large as his intelligence (it takes damage of every kind before his health). Up to 3 charges; the barrier fades 12 seconds after his last spell.
ROW2 COL3: Holy Beam. Winged white-gold swordsman planted in place firing one long focused white-gold beam straight through dark enemies; drained blue mana wisps at contact. Effect: Thyrandael shoots a beam of light 800 long for up to 7 seconds. Enemies in the beam take 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 magic damage and lose 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 mana every second, and are slowed by 30% while it touches them. He cannot move while he holds it; a move order turns him (60% slower than usual) and the beam turns with him. Press S (Stop) to end it.
ROW2 COL4: Quick Flash. A brilliant compact white-gold radial flash bursting from a winged figure; several nearby enemies carry repeated small gold light marks. Effect: A quick blast of light around Thyrandael (500): 30 / 50 / 70 / 90 magic damage, and a mark on every enemy hit for 10 seconds. The marks stack and renew: each mark an enemy already has adds 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 magic damage to the next Quick Flash. It does not stop Holy Beam.
ROW3 COL1: Spirit Step. Winged white-gold swordsman appears instantly at a second location and stamps a bright circular wave; dim abandoned silhouette behind him and a silenced enemy at landing. Effect: Thyrandael steps to the target spot at once and stomps the ground with divine light: enemies within 300 are silenced for 1 / 1.4 / 1.8 / 2.2 seconds and slowed by 40% for 1 second.
ROW3 COL2: False Judgement. A large concentrated gold-white blast at a distant spot catches multiple enemies; a bright charge cluster feeds it and blinded silhouettes stagger in the light. Effect: Thyrandael gains a charge for every 300 / 250 / 200 damage he takes, up to 10 / 11 / 12. He spends them all on a violent burst of light at a spot (400): for 5 seconds enemies miss up to 40 / 70 / 100% of their attacks, are slowed by up to 55% and take up to 60 / 80 / 100 magic damage a second, each by the share of charges he held. Its range (up to 800 / 1200 / 1600) also follows the charges, and its cooldown runs from 10 / 9 / 8 seconds down to 6 / 5 / 4 at full charges. Needs a charge.
ROW3 COL3: Giant Swing. Massive red-caped steel knight raises a huge sword overhead then brings it down through a forward red cone, splitting ground and knocking enemies down; gold spell protection around his shoulders, no horizontal spin. Effect: Ser Emelrich winds up for 1.8 / 1.6 / 1.4 seconds (a red cone for everyone to see: get out of it), then brings the sword down through a cone 700 long and 100 degrees wide: 250 / 375 / 500 physical damage that ignores 65% of armor, and every enemy hit is knocked down (stunned) for 2.5 / 3.5 / 4.5 seconds. Every tree in the cone falls. While he winds up he has Spell Immunity: the debuffs on him are removed and no new one lands, so nothing but death stops the swing. Upgrade Staff: 0.5 seconds later he swings back the other way (a smaller cone, half damage).
ROW3 COL4: Death Order. One large brilliant WHITE SILVER DAGGER striking a frail dark target silhouette above a LARGE ALMOST EMPTY HEALTH BAR: black rectangular bar spans85% cell width, with only left10% filled vivid red, remaining90% empty black inside thick pale rim. Health bar across lower quarter, easily visible at32px, no letters. Pure attack against already low-health targets, NOT guaranteed killing or summoned reaper. Effect: Caziel strikes hardest when an enemy is about to die: his attacks deal pure damage to enemies below 10 / 12 / 14% health.
Remaining cells13-16 empty dark charcoal only, no extra objects. Exact4x4grid. No text.

ROW2 COL1: Angry Forest. Several large angry trees lash inward with living vines at a trapped enemy; many distinct trunks around the scene, green nature light. Effect: Gancho wakes the forest for 7 seconds. Every second each tree within 1000 of him lashes the nearest enemy within 350 of it with a vine: 35 / 50 / 65 magic damage and a 0.4 second root (a unit is rooted at most once every 1.5 seconds, and takes at most two lashes a second). Gancho attacks 30 / 45 / 60 faster meanwhile.
ROW2 COL2: Momentum. Heavy steel-and-gold knight runs forward with lance lowered, dust and speed streaks converging into the lance tip for a stronger strike. Effect: Lord Kaileh hits harder the faster he moves: 30% of his bonus movement speed is added to his attack damage.

Other enemies in his way take the damage and are pushed aside.
ROW2 COL4: Lance Sweep. Steel-and-gold knight sweeps his long lance in a broad circle, knocking two enemies outward to opposite sides; curved weapon motion dominates. Effect: Lord Kaileh swings his lance round him (350): enemies take 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 physical damage, are pushed 150 away and slowed by 30% for 2 seconds.
ROW3 COL1: War Banner. A sturdy red-and-gold cloth banner on a planted pole radiates warm protective rings around allied armored figures; an enemy outside the ring drags its feet. Effect: Lord Kaileh plants his house banner for 12 seconds. Allies within 600 have 3 / 4 / 5 / 6 more armor and attack 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 faster; enemies within 600 move 10% slower. Four attacks bring it down; spells do not hurt it.
ROW3 COL2: Cavalry Charge. Steel-and-gold lance knight charges forward flanked by six translucent ghost riders in a wide formation, shattered trees and dust in their path. Current game riders are GHOST COPIES OF A LANCE KNIGHT ON FOOT, no horses, ghost knight formation charges forward. Front knight largest. Effect: Lord Kaileh charges up to 1600 with six ghost riders at his sides, trampling the trees in his way. Enemies in the 400 wide path take 200 / 300 / 400 magic damage, are pushed aside and stunned for 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 seconds. Nothing can slow or move him while he charges.

ROW1 COL4: Dragon Hide. Close view of layered pink dragon scales hardening into gold-edged armor, a soft green healing light underneath; passive armor and regeneration. Effect: Dracoxinia's scales harden: 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 more armor and 1.5 / 3 / 4.5 / 6 more health regeneration.
